# Fast Christmas Light Installation

> Christmas light installation for homes in Scarborough, Toronto, Ontario: lights put up before the holidays and taken down in the new year, or Govee permanent outdoor lights that stay up. Plug-in lighting only: no electrical work, which in Ontario is for licensed electrical contractors. Not affiliated with, sponsored by or authorized by Govee.

- Phone: (416) 820-3775
- Service area: Scarborough, Toronto, ON

## Guides

- [Can you cut Govee permanent outdoor lights? (length planner)](https://christmaslightsscarborough.ca/can-you-cut-govee-permanent-outdoor-lights/): Depends on the model. The Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights 2 can't be cut; the Pro can, in runs up to 200 ft. See the lengths and plan your roofline.
